scope: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: feature hypothesis selected from training errors. NestedCV evaluates a fixed procedure, not new independent validation. Never read654; no app/runtime promotion.
predictors: Candidate92+92missing indicators; reference75+75missing indicators. No basefeature/guard changes.
grouping: Existing whole-game/identical-before union components; both windows linked; deterministic salted SHA256 group sort then round-robin folds; common bootstrap RNG across costs
selection: MaxTP with FP<=min(referenceFP,floor(.005*N_non_easy_negatives)),TP>=referenceTP,TP>0. Ties fewerFP/highercutoff/highercost. If none feasible select cost5/cutoff5/6 reference and explicit no qualifying improvement.
reference: Original75+75 features only, depth6/minleaf8/mtry12,cost5/cutoff5/6 retrained on exactly same trainingfolds/bootstrap/RNG.
guards: Both-window eligibility+confidence+physicalUnknown abstention for all forest predictions. Easy-error negatives separate; legacy_mixed treated as hard.
final_selection: Independent fixed5fold OOF on all frozen training only; not chosen using outer results. Fullfit once at selectedcost, separate threshold config.
start: Root GO hashes input/script/protocol; browser tabs closed; no active stockfish; no fit before GO
capacity_tie: Same capacity; exact TP/FP/cutoff/cost ties prefer firstlisted reference (no gratuitous addedfeatures).
advancement: Researchadvancement requires pooledouterTP>referenceTP AND pooledouterFP<=referenceFP. Literal counts distinguish modest versus large gain. No90percentclaim, no promotion. Selector is unchanged; no threshold/parameter changes after outcomes.
inference: score_model in frozen optimize-pv.py accepts original150 or augmented184 schema. Same64raw-leaf mean, bothwindowcutoff, eligibility/confidence/physicalUnknown. Forest model features+trees; cutoff/schema separate.
